C-2 / Orrery / authoritative transport vocabulary
PTP: omit reason — saved promise
No-PTP: R01 refusal or no eligible commitment; R07 dispute; R99 save failure
Xfer: H1 human transfer
ID0: F1 failed security; D1 declined security
NR0: U0 unclear holder; N0 relative/no contact; W0 wrong number; D0 deceased
Queue: Desk-1 only.
add_note transport enum: R01, R07, R99. The campaign never uses this endpoint and has no active note reasons.
Callback endpoint retained, not enabled; no callback outcome or window.
All codes are case-sensitive strings; digits in codes are not numeric values.
